units.source_text: 暂时气绝似的老妪，从死尸间挣起伊裸露的身子来，是相去不久的事。

en.t: Before long, the old woman, who had seemed for a while to have stopped breathing, struggled her naked body up from among the corpses.

units.source_text: 伊吐出唠叨似的呻吟似的声音，

en.t: She let out a rambling, groaning sound,

units.source_text: 借了还在燃烧的火光，爬到楼梯口边去。

en.t: using the light of the fire that was still burning, and crawled over to the stairway entrance.

units.source_text: 而且从这里倒挂了短的白发，窥向门下面。

en.t: Then from there she let her short white hair hang upside down and peered beneath the gate.

units.source_text: 那外边，只有黑洞洞的昏夜。

en.t: Outside there was only the pitch-dark night.
